description_en: Adds available employees to an invoice title
description_zh: 增加发票抬头可用员工
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen invoice-rule-add --third-part-id 4854821 --entities entity_type=1 entity_name=张三 entity_id=12345 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvoiceRuleAdd

fields.help_en: The ID of the available scope entity, such as an employee ID, department ID, role ID, or third-party department ID
fields.help_zh: 可用范围实体id：人员id，部门id，角色id，第三方部门id
fields.name: entity_id

fields.help_en: The name of the available scope entity, such as an employee name, department name, role name, or third-party department name
fields.help_zh: 可用范围实体名：人员姓名，部门名，角色名，第三方部门名
fields.name: entity_name

fields.help_en:
The type of the available scope. Valid values:
1: employee.
2: department.
3: role.
4: third-party department
fields.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise access credential" API (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as a substitute
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

message.description_en: The remarks that describe the result
message.description_zh: 备注，结果的备注，如对结果的说明

module.description_en: The return value from the server. Returns null if no result is available or an exception occurs
module.description_zh: 返回值，服务端返回，没有结果或发生异常都返回空

add_num.description_en: The number of employees, departments, or roles that were added
add_num.description_zh: 增加的人员/部门/角色个数

selected_user_num.description_en: The number of entities under the invoice title
selected_user_num.description_zh: 该发票抬头下的实体个数

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Set to false by the server when an exception occurs. Also set to false if the result is null
success.description_zh: 成功标识，由服务端设置，发生异常时为false。结果为null设置为false
